translations.web: How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? For Yahweh has created a new thing in the earth: a woman will encompass a man.”
translations.bsb: How long will you wander, O faithless daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the land— a woman will shelter a man.”
translations.kjv: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
translations.asv: How long wilt thou go hither and thither, O thou backsliding daughter? for Jehovah hath created a new thing in the earth: a woman shall encompass a man.
